ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET source = EXCLUDED.source, started_at = EXCLUDED.started_at, finished_at = EXCLUDED.finished_at,
  status = EXCLUDED.status, rows_upserted = EXCLUDED.rows_upserted, error = EXCLUDED.error

nodes.name: Send alert email (enable after attaching SMTP)

parameters.content:
## Ingest error handler

The poll already names this workflow as its **Error workflow** (fixed id `ingestErrorHandler01`); publish this one so n8n runs it. When that workflow stops, this writes a `failed` row to `ingest_log`, so the dashboard's Data health page shows it, and it ends in a disabled email node. To get alerts: set real from/to addresses, attach an SMTP credential and enable that node (or swap in Slack). If the database is down, the log write continues to the alert node. No notification is sent while it is disabled.
